annotations.target_phrase: Screaming Fist, Case. You’ve heard the name.
annotations.annotation_text: Operation Screaming Fist: a clandestine cyber-warfare military assault launched by the US military against Soviet computer installations in Siberia during a fictional third world conflict.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 31.

annotations.target_phrase: assault on the Kirensk computer nexus. Basic module was a Nightwing micro light
annotations.annotation_text: The historical origin of cyber-warfare in Gibson's universe: military-grade polymorphic virus programs developed to penetrate enemy military mainframes, later privatized into criminal icebreakers.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 31.

annotations.target_phrase: Ice from ICE, intrusion countermeasures electronics
annotations.annotation_text: Gibson's foundational coinage of ICE (Intrusion Countermeasures Electronics), the defensive software barriers and lethal Black ICE firewalls that protect corporate and military databases in cyberspace.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 31.
Paul Brians. Study Guide for William Gibson: Neuromancer (1984).
